summary: TETRA Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 10,810,811 shares of common stock at $9.25 per share, raising approximately $94.5 million in net proceeds. The offering is an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation. Shares trade on NYSE under TTI. Underwriters have a 30-day over-allotment option for 1,621,621 additional shares. Terms are standard for a marketed equity offering. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category applies. What to watch: typical secondary offering execution and stock price impact post-pricing.
